ticketTitle: Fix: Outlet list search only filters current page (client-side, not server-side)
ticketDescription:
## Source

Discovery `search-across-features`, file: `.caf/discovery/search-across-features/prd.md` + `flow.md`

## Problem

Outlet list page (`apps/web/src/modules/outlet/pages/index.vue:269`) does client-side filtering (`filteredOutlets` computed) over data that is already paginated from the server. Search only narrows results within the currently loaded page (e.g. 10 items), not across all of the merchant's outlets — results are incomplete/wrong once outlets exceed one page.

## Target User

Internal merchant staff managing outlets, especially merchants with more outlets than fit on one page.

## Scope of This Ticket

* Backend: add a dedicated query DTO for the outlets list endpoint (follow `ProductsQueryDto` / `CategoriesQueryDto` pattern) with an optional `search` field; confirm covered fields (`name`, `location` per discovery draft) and wire into the Prisma `where` clause, scoped by `merchant_id`.
* Frontend: remove the client-side `filteredOutlets` computed filter; instead call `fetchOutlet()` with a `search` param (same pattern already used by merchant/categories), so results cover all outlet data, not just the current page.
* Reset `pagination.page` to 1 whenever the search keyword changes (existing pattern in merchant/categories).

## Out-of-Scope

* Full-text/fuzzy search, cross-module search.
* Adding automated test coverage for this page (pre-existing gap).
* Changing the base `PaginationDto` globally.

## Flow

User types in `UiSearch` → 300ms debounce (existing) → frontend now calls `GET /outlets?search=...` (replacing the old client-side filter) → backend filters and returns matching outlets with pagination computed from the filtered set → `pagination.page` resets to 1.

## Success Metric

Search returns correct results across the entire outlet dataset, not just the currently loaded page; no regression to loading/empty-state UI.

## Dependency

* Open question (from discovery): confirm exact fields covered by outlet search (`name` + `location`) with product owner.
* Page has no detected automated test coverage — verify manually before merge.
